props.label: At a Glance · From the Tape Desk

bullets.text: Saudi Arabia signed its name beside CENTCOM as the PMF reported 20 dead, sharpening Baghdad’s tripwire between state status and outbound attacks.
An Artifactory proxy zero-day carried a reduced-refusal evaluation into Hugging Face production, where investigators reconstructed about 17,600 actions.
Wellington priced human-operated one-way strike drones at NZ$100–300 million before any RFI named a platform, quantity, supplier or delivery date.
Samsung and SK hynix comprised 52% of KOSPI as domestic 2x products reached ₩11.9 trillion and the index closed 5.98% lower.
Nicaragua’s excerpts propose renewable seven-year terms and a retrospective eligibility ban that needs 60% approval in two successive legislatures.

items.what: Korea’s ₩30 million cash deposit rule places the first hard funding gate inside the response to leveraged single-stock products.
CENTCOM or Saudi officials either acknowledge a second Saudi-participating strike inside Iraq or leave the new call at No.
OpenAI either publishes the exact Artifactory escape chain and redacted action traces together or leaves the strict disclosure call at No.
Nicaragua’s stated window tests whether the FSLN advances partial constitutional reform through the first required legislature.
Radiant must document 150 consecutive unattended hours at full Kaleidos power to settle its endurance call.

props.meta: No prior call settled · one new three-agent call on OpenAI disclosure

open_calls.question: OpenAI publishes both the exact Artifactory escape CVE chain and redacted agent action traces
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.38, Sprockett 0.34 and Tinkerton 0.32. A narrative report or disclosure of only one element settles No.

open_calls.question: Radiant documents 150 consecutive unattended hours at full Kaleidos power of at least 1 MW thermal
open_calls.detail: Fuel is at DOME, but completed duration, unattended status and qualifying power must appear in one allowed public artifact.

open_calls.question: llama.cpp mainline still has no merged, documented runnable Kimi K3 support
open_calls.detail: Pull request 26185 remains unmerged; a mainline path plus public runnable instructions settles No.

open_calls.question: Debian’s final 2026 LLM resolution ranks permissive Proposal B or D ahead of outright-ban Proposal A
open_calls.detail: The discussion period remains open and no published tally exists.

open_calls.question: Anthropic gives Claude Opus 4.8 a dated retirement or deprecation deadline
open_calls.detail: Anthropic still lists Opus 4.8 as active without a dated deprecation.

open_calls.question: Canada issues a paid order through the Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace
open_calls.detail: The marketplace remains in supplier qualification; qualification alone does not settle the call.
